entries.subject: Radius
entries.finding: 1.24 Jupiter radii from the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated radius (its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, since 55 Cnc b does not transit.

entries.subject: Mass
entries.finding: 0.8684 Jupiter masses: Moutou et al. (2026), A&A 705, A190, Table 3: minimum mass (m sin i) 276 +/- 9 Earth masses from the star's radial velocities; at the assumed tilt of 93.9 degrees the mass is 0.2% more (https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.11523).
